Editorial heading; no runtime credit.
* You can now control for which specialization you will receive loot from LFR/Quests. No award-policy state or setter; constant-zero GetLootSpecialization is publication only, not modeled selection.

* The number of pet stable pages has increased from 2 to 5 (Increasing the number of slots from 20 to 50). Historical five-page/fifty-slot stable layout is not demonstrated by current stable APIs/fixtures. No 2013 roster/page model introduced.

* Knowledge base and GM tickets now use an embedded web browser to interact with Blizzard's Support website. Current Browser creation maps to a generic frame, with no embedded web engine, support-service persistence or native browsing. Intentional unsupported browser domain; not modeled parity.

** The embedded browser functionality is encapsulated by the Browser widget type. Current Browser creation maps to a generic frame, with no embedded web engine, support-service persistence or native browsing. Intentional unsupported browser domain; not modeled parity.
